steps.text: Ask Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle for a quest and he'll give you an air talisman.
chat: 1. Have you any quests for me?

steps.text: Talk to Archmage Sedridor in the Wizards' Tower basement and give him the air talisman.
Talk to Aubury south of Varrock east bank in the Varrock rune shop and give him the research package.
chat: 1. I've been sent here with a package for you.

steps.text: Take the research notes back to Sedridor.
